import numpy as np
from scipy import stats
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from collections import defaultdict

MAX_DRIVERS = 5

def design(feats):
    # Simple approach: rank by effect size and select top features
    effects = []
    for fid in feats.ids:
        col_idx = feats.column(fid)
        if col_idx < feats.x.shape[1]:
            x_col = feats.x[:, col_idx]
            effect = abs(np.mean(x_col[feats.y==1]) - np.mean(x_col[feats.y==0]))
            effects.append((effect, fid))
    
    effects.sort(reverse=True)
    top_features = [fid for _, fid in effects[:MAX_DRIVERS]]
    
    # Select features for regression (limit to 10 to avoid overfitting)
    columns = tuple(top_features[:10])
    
    # Build loadings based on correlation with outcome
    loadings = {}
    for fid in columns:
        col_idx = feats.column(fid)
        x_col = feats.x[:, col_idx]
        corr = np.corrcoef(x_col, feats.y)[0,1]
        loadings[fid] = abs(corr)
    
    # Add interaction terms for highly correlated pairs (limit to 5 pairs)
    products = []
    corr_pairs = [(a,b) for a,b,r in [
        ("NXAE17","NQBG5P",0.99), ("DOYC16A","SPFJ2",0.94), ("GSH1A","XXRC2",-0.91),
        ("XXRC2","SPFJ2",-0.90), ("DKEL4","BRD18A",0.89), ("LPND9","CPB2P",0.88),
        ("GSH1A","TPC8",-0.87), ("WHS4","XXRC2",0.86), ("WHS4","SPFJ2",-0.85),
        ("GSH1A","WNE14",0.85), ("WNE14","XXRC2",-0.85), ("XXRC2","TPC8",0.83),
        ("XXRC2","AEG14",0.83), ("DFG19","TPC8",0.82), ("WNE14","TPC8",-0.82),
        ("GSH1A","DFG19",-0.82), ("XXRC2","DFG19",0.82), ("WHS4","FHS12L",0.81),
        ("WHS4","GTPI9",0.81), ("WHS4","DOYC16A",-0.81)
    ] if a in feats.ids and b in feats.ids and abs(r) >= 0.6]
    
    for a, b in corr_pairs[:5]:  # Limit to 5 interaction terms
        if a in columns and b in columns:
            products.append((a, b))
    
    return Design(
        drivers=(),
        columns=columns,
        products=tuple(products),
        loadings=loadings
    )
